(a) tidak kurang daripada lima puluh peratus daripada jumlah fi yang

dan

Remitan

3. Ketua Pengarah Agensi Angkasa Negara boleh meremitkan fi yang ditetapkan
di bawah Perintah ini sama ada secara keseluruhan atau sebahagian atau secara am
atau dalam mana-mana kes atau kelas kes yang tertentu.

FEES ACT 1951

FEES (NATIONAL SPACE AGENCY) ORDER 2017

IN exercise of the powers conferred by sections 3 and 10 of the Fees Act 1951
[Act 209], the Yang di-Pertuan Agong makes the following order:

Citation and commencement
1. (1) This order may be cited as the Fees (National Space Agency)
Order 2017.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 1 March 2017.

Fees and payment of fees
2. (1) The fees prescribed in  column (2) of  the Schedule shall be paid to the
Director General of the National Space Agency for the services specified in column (1)
in accordance with the unit specified in column (3).

(2) The fees prescribed under this Order shall be payable as follows:

(a) not less than fifty percent from the total fees payable  shall be paid
before the services are rendered; and

(b)  the remaining fees payable  after payment in subsubparagraph (a)
is made, shall be paid in full after the services have been rendered.

Remission
3. The Director General of the National Space Agency may remit the fees prescribed
under this Order either wholly or in part or generally or in any particular case or class
of cases.
